collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLC Class Coupe 2016 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz GLC Coupe 2016 Onwards (C253) requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
